messages.subject: Fatal error with validate
parts:
I have a validate(need..) statement inside a reactive object. When the need condition is met, the error message shows up in the console, but the app crashes instead of displaying the message to the user. 

Unfortunately I cannot provide a reproducible example because this is pretty specific to a private report. Has anyone run into a similar issue before?

Thanks,

Alex
